title: Disagreement-Guided Agentic Data Curation for Multimodal Safety
abstract: arXiv:2607.14256v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Written safety policies in multimodal settings define categories whose visual boundaries span many contexts. We study disagreement as a signal for identifying useful synthetic boundary cases. Our pipeline generates policy-conditioned images, selects cases with target--rater or inter-rater disagreement, conditionally escalates unresolved cases, and retrieves the resulting rater-labeled examples as in-context demonstrations. On a failure-enriched multimodal safety benchmark, policy grounding reduces false negative rate (FNR) from 0.875 to 0.413 and raises F1 from 0.220 to 0.731; retrieval from 50 disagreement-selected examples further reduces FNR to 0.245, compared with 0.297 from a 350-example Regular pool. The selected memory also improves a different target-model family, with a smaller gain on a proprietary benchmark with a refined policy. translated_title: 面向多模态安全的分歧引导式智能体数据筛选
translated_abstract: 在多模态场景中，书面安全策略所定义的类别，其视觉边界横跨众多不同情境。我们研究将“分歧”作为信号，用于识别有用的合成边界案例。我们的流程会生成以策略为条件的图像，筛选出目标模型与标注者之间或标注者相互之间存在分歧的案例，并有条件地对未解决的案例进行升级处理，最后将由此获得的带标注者标签的示例检索出来，作为上下文演示。在一个富含失败案例的多模态安全基准上，策略对齐将假阴性率（FNR）从 0.875 降低至 0.413，并将 F1 从 0.220 提升至 0.731；从 50 个由分歧筛选出的示例中进行检索，进一步将 FNR 降至 0.245，而从 350 个示例组成的常规池中检索的 FNR 为 0.297。所筛选出的记忆库还能提升另一类目标模型家族的表现，但在采用精炼策略的专有基准上提升幅度较小。在一项盲测人类研究中，专家在分歧引导图像上有 24% 的意见不一致，而在基线图像上为 17%（摘要内容在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出以标注者分歧为信号来筛选合成策略边界案例并作为上下文演示检索使用，显著提升了多模态安全判别性能，将假阴性率从 0.875 降至 0.245，F1 从 0.220 升至 0.731。
en_tdlr: Using rater disagreement as a signal to curate and retrieve synthetic policy-boundary cases as in-context demonstrations substantially improves multimodal safety, reducing FNR from 0.875 to 0.245 and raising F1 from 0.220 to 0.731.
